profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer → AI Engineer | .NET, Microservices & LLM Systems (RAG, Agents) | Relocating to Austin, TX
profile.summary:
I'm a Senior Software Engineer with 16 years building enterprise software — currently at Chubb, where I develop, maintain, and operate large-scale data transmission channels moving millions of records daily to multiple clients, built on SQL Server, SSIS, and .NET.
I'm now transitioning into AI Engineering, focused on production LLM systems: RAG pipelines, AI agents, and evaluation-driven development. I already build with AI daily — using Claude to generate development agents for coding, testing, and DevOps across C#, Python, and SQL Server — and I'm earning the NVIDIA Certified Professional – Agentic AI (NCP-AAI) certification.
My background in enterprise SDLC, automated testing, and large-scale data systems is what I bring to AI: making LLM applications reliable, observable, and cost-effective in production.
Open to AI Engineer roles in Austin, TX — relocating from Dallas–Fort Worth in 2027.
U.S. Permanent Resident — authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship.

- Develop frontend web applications in ASP.NET providing self-service tools to internal users across the organization
- Ensure reliability, monitoring, and performance of mission-critical data pipelines

projects.title: Pipeline Sentinel — Agentic Data Pipeline Monitoring
projects.description: Monitoring agent for data pipelines: scheduled volume, freshness, schema and quality checks with LangGraph-based alert triage (deterministic severity + LLM root-cause suggestions). APScheduler, Streamlit dashboard, and an eval harness with synthetic anomaly injection — 6/6 anomalies detected, 0 false positives. 34 tests.

projects.title: RAG Assistant — Agentic Document Q&A
projects.description: Agentic RAG system that answers questions over your documents. LangGraph agent (retrieve → grade → rewrite → generate), Chroma vector store, local LLM via Ollama, FastAPI + Streamlit, and a custom eval harness (faithfulness & answer relevance with a local LLM judge). 31 tests.
